name: DARE-bench
intro: DARE-bench 是一个面向数据科学与机器学习建模任务的基准，用于评估大模型在复杂多步数据科学任务中的建模能力与指令忠实度，并提供可验证真值以支持客观评测。
build_method: Kaggle开放数据采集, LLM任务构造, 受控后处理, 可验证真值
metric: IF精确匹配, Macro-F1, 截断R²
modality: 文本, 代码, 表格
task_type: 代码生成, 数据科学建模, 时间序列预测
eval_feature: 可验证真值, 指令遵循, 过程评估
intro_en: DARE-bench is a benchmark for data science and machine learning modeling tasks. It evaluates LLM agents on complex multi-step data science workflows, instruction fidelity, and objectively verifiable outcomes.
build_method_en: Open Kaggle Data Collection, LLM Task Design, Controlled Post-Processing, Verifiable Ground Truth
metric_en: IF Exact Match, Macro-F1, Clipped R²
task_type_en: Code Generation, Data Science Modeling, Time Series Forecasting
eval_feature_en: Verifiable Ground Truth, Instruction Following, Process Evaluation
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the ICLR 2026 paper arXiv:2602.24288 and the official Snowflake repository. The paper benchmark contains 5,948 training and 352 evaluation tasks: Classification-IF/MM each 1,160/74, Regression-IF/MM each 899/45, and Time-series-XF/CF each 915/57. The official repository currently publishes a smaller license-filtered subset of 4,274 training and 324 evaluation tasks; the diagram intentionally uses the paper's full 6,300-task contract. Open-license tabular Kaggle data and crawled metadata feed LLM feasibility analysis. Random or chronological splits, about 20% IF training-noise injection, entity checks, and resampling create the variants. IF outputs come from sandboxed reference code with a fixed seed, while MM and time-series variants use masked original labels. The standard evaluation uses five turns and a 200-second sandbox maximum per turn; IF uses exact match, Classification-MM Macro-F1, and regression/time-series clipped R².
